instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 crowns broccoli
3 limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli crowns into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a large bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, and toss to combine; transfer to one large or two medium baking sheets and spread out in a single, even layer. Reserve bowl for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cooking in batches if necessary, Place broccoli (one baking sheet at a time) in the oven and broil, turning halfway through, until broccoli is crisp-tender and lightly charred around the edges, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest the limes into the large bowl, then juice half of the limes into the same bowl. Cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside.
Peel and mince the shallot and garlic. Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer everything to the bowl with the lime juice.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ shallots
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar to the bowl and whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done cooking, remove from the oven and transfer to the bowl with the sauce; stir to combine.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Large dice tofu (cut into 2-cm cubes) and place in another large medium bowl. Add cornstarch, salt, and pepper to the bowl and gently toss to coat the tofu.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add the tofu in a single layer and cook, flipping every 1-2 minutes with a spatula, until golden and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the broccoli.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
When the tofu is done cooking, add edamame to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until cooked through, about 2 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the broccoli and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the broccoli mixture between bowls or plates; top with almonds and garnish with lime wedges. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ mangoes
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and grate or mince the ginger.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add ginger, water, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Combine vinegar, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to dissolve the sugar.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim cucumbers and thinly slice crosswise into rounds. Add to the bowl with the vinegar mixture.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl with the cucumber. Stir to combine the salad.
Peel mangos and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and set aside.
Combine chili-garlic sauce and mayonnaise in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
⅓ cup vegan mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out, keeping avocado halves intact. Fill avocado halves with spicy mayo.
Divide rice, edamame, mango, and cucumber-radish salad between bowls; top with an avocado half. Serve with soy sauce on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup all-purpose flour
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cube steak, add to bowl, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry potatoes, carrots, celery, and green onions. Peel and medium dice potatoes and carrots. Trim ends and medium dice celery. Trim root ends and chop onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes total.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onions, and garlic. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, water, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until vegetables are tender, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 ¼ cups water
3 tbsp soy sauce
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place stew in a bowl and have with crusty bread. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic and shallots; place both in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop capers and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta in a colander and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse the beans; add to the bowl. Gently toss the salad to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls or plates. Garnish with pine nuts and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: Wash and cut cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium heads cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Place cauliflower, broth, polenta, and salt in a large pot. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the mixture has thickened, 20-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
40 fl oz (5 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup polenta (cornmeal)
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place tomato sauce, ketchup, Dijon, sugar, vinegar, and spices in a medium saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
3 tbsp ketchup
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice sausage into ½-inch rounds.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini, sausage, and corn to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and sausage is lightly browned, 5-7 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions).
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Pour the sauce into the skillet and toss to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower grits between plates or bowls. Top with vegetables and sausage. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
3 limes
3 medium carrots
3 tomatoes
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the jalapeño into rounds; remove seeds and add to the bowl with the garlic. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Juice limes into the bowl. Add soy sauce, sugar, and oil; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup soy sauce
¼ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add edamame, return to a boil, and cook until tender, about 2 minutes. Remove pot from the heat and add rice noodles. Let noodles soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain noodles and edamame in a colander and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups edamame
15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate the carrots. Transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut tomatoes into thin wedges and add to the bowl.
Halve each cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Pick mint leaves off the stems. Roughly chop leaves and add to the bowl.
Add drained noodles and edamame to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide noodle salad between bowls and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 limes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 red chili peppers
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Juice half of the limes into the bowl. Cut remaining limes into wedges and transfer to a large plate; set aside.
Add soy sauce, oil, and vinegar to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup soy sauce
⅓ cup toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
24 oz veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: Pour ⅓ of the dressing over the veggie ground and stir to combine; bring to a simmer and continue to cook until reduced, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice cucumbers into rounds; add to the plate with the lime wedges.
Pick basil leaves off the stems and add to the plate.
Trim and thinly slice chili peppers into rounds; add to the plate. (Be careful with chilies; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate.
Separate lettuce into leaves; divide lettuce, veggie ground, lime wedges, cucumber, basil, chili pepper, and avocado between plates. Serve with remaining dressing on the side for dipping and enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Coat another large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup ketchup
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; transfer to the baking sheet. Pour ⅔ of the BBQ sauce over the tofu and turn to coat. Set remaining sauce aside.
Place tofu in the oven and broil until the top starts to brown and caramelize, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add blue cheese and stir to combine the dressing; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Remove tofu from the oven, flip, and coat with remaining BBQ sauce. Return to the oven and broil until brown and caramelized on the other side, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 Gala apples
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of each cabbage. Cut cabbage heads into quarters lengthwise, to make six wedges.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples.
Chop chives into small pieces.
To serve, divide tofu and cabbage wedges between plates; top wedges with dressing, apples, and chives. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs and broth to the bowl with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl; whisk to combine. Gradually add the egg mixture to the bowl with the flour, whisking to create a smooth batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup all-purpose flour
1 tbsp baking powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the batter and stir until thoroughly combined.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add one-sixth of the pancake batter (1¼-cups per pancake) to the skillet and smooth out into a large, ½-inch thick pancake. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with mayo and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the green onions.
Once the first pancake is done cooking, add more oil (about 1 teaspoon per pancake) to the skillet and repeat with remaining batter.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place a pancake on each plate. Top with green onions and avocado; drizzle with spicy mayo and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ small pkgs fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl.
Add soy sauce, oil, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the lime juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice the onion into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbages; halve each cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumbers, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice crosswise; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
6 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: While the sausages are cooking, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the edamame and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice sausages.
To serve, divide salad and sausage slices between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions; drain in a colander and rinse.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
3 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 lime
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, return them to the reserved bowl.
Return the pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, ginger, and onion to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut milk, water, soy sauce, maple syrup, and spices to the pot; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) cans coconut milk
¾ cup water
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce is simmering, add drained rice noodles, edamame, and cooked veggies to the pot; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles are warmed through and sauce has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges; set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide saucy noodles and veggies between bowls; top with a squeeze of lime and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ bunches radish
3 limes
1 ½ mangoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a medium saucepan; stir to combine. Bring the pickling liquid to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup rice vinegar
¾ cup water
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and cut carrots into thin matchsticks. Trim and thinly slice radishes.
Once the pickling liquid has come to a boil, add carrots and radishes; stir to combine, remove from heat, and set aside to cool.
Peel and mince garlic. Place half the garlic in a small bowl (reserving the rest for the next step); add mayo and stir to combine the garlic aioli. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
½ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl; add remaining garlic, oil, sugar, soy sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the salad dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp soy sauce
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Roughly chop and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Transfer to a plate.

Thinly slice the jalapeño peppers into rounds; add to the plate with the cucumber. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the mango; place the other half on the plate with the veggies. Set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
12 eggs

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the mango and cilantro. Toss to combine the salad.
Split rolls in half; working in batches if necessary, toast, cut-side down, in another skillet over medium-high heat or in a toaster (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Divide toasted rolls between plates; spread each half with a layer of garlic aioli, then top with cucumber, pickled carrots and radish, eggs, jalapeños, and cilantro. Drizzle with soy sauce and season with pepper. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp soy sauce
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
3 red chili peppers
2 small bunches cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Place oil, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and salt in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and halve cucumbers lengthwise; cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Thinly slice the chili peppers into rounds; add to the bowl with the cucumber. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Place in another large bowl.
Crack eggs into the bowl with the green onions. Add soy sauce and whisk to combine the egg batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Add one-sixth of the egg batter (a scant 1 cup per omelet) to the skillet and swirl to cover the bottom. As eggs begin to set, use a spatula to pull the cooked edges towards the center. Then tilt the skillet, allowing the uncooked egg to move to the edges. Cook until set, about 3 minutes.
Fold the omelet in half and remove to a plate; cut in half. Loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Return skillet to medium heat and add more oil (about 1½ teaspoons per omelet). Repeat with remaining egg batter.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, salad, and omelets between plates. Spoon chili-garlic sauce over the omelets and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
12 oz macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
2 green bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Place curry paste, oil, soy sauce, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, green
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp soy sauce
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into two triangles. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu to the baking sheet. Drizzle with half of the spice paste. (Reserve bowl with remaining spice paste for the salad.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the remaining spice paste. Add maple syrup and stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl, along with the carrots, and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted
1 ½ (10 oz) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tofu and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the broccoli and set aside.
Juice lemons into a small bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo and spices; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oz Parmesan cheese
¾ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp basil, dried
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer pressed tofu to the cutting board and wipe the baking sheet dry with paper towels. Return tofu to the baking sheet and coat with oil on both sides. Place tofu in the oven and broil until warmed through, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli, zucchini, pine nuts, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often until veggies are tender-crisp, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup pine nuts
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is done, remove from the oven. Carefully flip, then spread the tops with the mayo mixture. Return to the oven and continue to broil until topping is browned, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide tofu and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with veggie ground, bread crumbs, mayo, soy sauce, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry portobello mushrooms. Remove stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; place cap-side down on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using your hands, divide veggie ground mixture between the insides of mushrooms, spreading evenly to the edges. Gently press to adhere.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties, veggie ground-side down and cook, undisturbed, until the golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Flip patties, top with cheese, and cook until mushrooms are golden brown and fork-tender, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Place in a clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the onion along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Toast buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Place oven racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb new potatoes
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes and divide between two additional large baking sheets.
Peel, halve, and large dice onions. Add to the baking sheets with the potatoes, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets on lower racks of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and large dice zucchini. Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Place both in a large bowl and set aside.
Zest lemons into a small bowl. Juice lemons into another small bowl.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest and half to the bowl with the lemon juice. (Set the bowl with the lemon juice aside for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the gremolata topping.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Wipe the baking sheet dry with paper towels, then coat with a thin layer of oil. Return tofu to the baking sheet, sprinkle with gremolata topping, and press gently to adhere. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Once the potatoes have softened, remove from oven. Add zucchini and bell pepper to the baking sheets, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer.

Return veggies to the oven, along with the tofu, placing tofu on the upper rack. Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender, gremolata topping is golden brown, and tofu is warmed through, 10-12 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add yogurt, mayo, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is done, remove baking sheets from the oven. Add olives to the veggies and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Divide tofu and veggies between plates or bowls. Serve with sauce on the side and enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chopped veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 tbsp curry powder
2 tbsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, medium dice tofu.
When the veggies are softened, add coconut milk, peanut butter, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and soy sauce to the pot. Stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) cans coconut milk
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the curry is simmering, add tofu and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and curry has thickened slightly, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from heat.
While the curry is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, water, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅓ cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat, add cilantro, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb new potatoes
¾ lb green beans
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes. Once the water in the pot is boiling, add potatoes and salt. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until starting to soften, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the potatoes are cooking, trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Once the potatoes start to soften, add green beans to the pot and continue to cook until veggies are tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ shallots
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve olives and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and quarter eggs lengthwise. Add to the bowl.
Add cooled potatoes and green beans to the bowl, then gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle oil over flatbread, season with spices, and cut into 1½-inch wide strips; transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 flatbreads or naan
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and spices; cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
3 heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the dill.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide salad between plates or bowls and top with tofu. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu and add to bowl with the marinade. Stir to coat and set aside.
While the tofu is marinating, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
9 baby bok choy
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in another large bowl.
Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a slotted spoon, add tofu to the pot, leaving the marinade in the bowl. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve marinade for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the veggies, reserved marinade, and water to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls; sprinkle with cashews. Enjoy!
Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pineapples
3 limes
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and slice lengthwise into thick planks. Place planks on a large plate, then drizzle with oil and season with salt on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor skillet, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches, add the pineapple planks and grill, turning occasionally, until tender and charred in spots, about 8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a large bowl, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tofu. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Thread tofu onto skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Return the pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches, add the tofu skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the tofu is warmed through and charred in spots, about 8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots. Place in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the shallot, then add soy sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Small dice pineapple, return to the plate, and drizzle with half of the dressing. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for the next step.)
Trim off and discard root end of the cabbages; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the reserved dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Roughly chop cashews. Add both to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Divide skewers and slaw between plates. Serve with pineapple salsa on the side and enjoy!
Wash and small dice the mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl. Peel and mince or grate the ginger; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb white mushrooms
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey, eggs, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the bowl and mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
3 eggs
⅜ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Form meat mixture into 1 inch size meatballs and place on a plate.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through and browned on all sides, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the carrots, cucumbers, green onions, and lettuce. Trim carrot ends, peel, and grate. Halve cucumbers lengthwise, then halve each half, and slice crosswise on an angle. Trim green onion ends and thinly slice on an angle.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and red pepper (optional).
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp toasted sesame oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper (optional)

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place meatballs in lettuce leaves and top with carrots and cucumber. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the ginger and garlic (set remainder aside for serving).
Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, oil, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the veggie ground mixture into rounded "meatballs" and place in the prepared dish.
Place meatballs in the oven and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, oil, and chili-garlic sauce in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the tempeh and grill until browned and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro

1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Separate lettuce leaves, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small flour tortillas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with tempeh, salsa, and lettuce. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs, Dijon, soy sauce, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk until smooth.

6 eggs
2 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two large baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Divide cheesy egg mixture between toast slices, spreading it to the edges. Working in batches, return toast to the oven and broil until topping is golden and bubbling at the edges, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces. Place half in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)

2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat. Set aside.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Divide between toasts, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide Welsh rarebit between plates and sprinkle with reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

instructions.primary_message: Coat the grill/skillet with oil. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
