instructions.primary_message: Peel and julienne (or cut into thin sticks) the mangoes; add to the large bowl with the cilantro. Seed and julienne (or cut into thin sticks) the bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince or press the garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, lime juice, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, water, and crushed red pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ limes
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp water
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour the dressing over top the salad and toss to combine.
Serve the grilled chicken with salad on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat two large baking dishes with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)

Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with beef, coconut aminos, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a generous tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs. Divide between the baking dishes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
1 tbsp coconut aminos
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a clean large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, medium dice bacon.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices bacon

instructions.primary_message: When the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-6 minutes.
When the bacon is done, add cabbage and spices to the pot, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide meatballs and bacon-fried cabbage between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
3 fennel bulbs
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula
1 ½ (3 oz) pkgs alfalfa sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls (set one bowl aside for the salad).
Add yogurt, mayo, Dijon, and spices to the remaining bowl with the parsley. Stir to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl with the creamy dressing; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu salad. Set aside. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for later use.)
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Zest and juice lemons into the second bowl with the parsley. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and salt, then whisk to combine the salad dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the salad dressing.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pistachios, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between reserved baking sheet and an additional baking sheet. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices whole grain bread

instructions.primary_message: Divide toast slices between plates, then layer with tofu salad and sprouts. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and press with the back of a spatula, to make a larger diameter patty; cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 veggie burger patties, plant-based

instructions.primary_message: Flip the burger patties, top with cheese, and continue to cook until cheese is melted and patties are golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes more (or cook patties according to package instructions). Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice three tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds; medium dice remaining tomatoes. Place slices on another plate and add diced tomato to the bowl with the dressing.

Separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside a few leaves per burger and chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add whole leaves to the plate and chopped lettuce to the bowl. Set the plate aside.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 12 small flour tortillas

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the burgers, place half of the tortillas on a flat surface, then top with cheesy burger patties, lettuce leaves, tomato slices, and special sauce. Close with the remaining tortillas and cut in half.
To serve, divide veggie burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fennel bulbs
6 leeks
1 ½ lb new potatoes
3 lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and dark green stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick wedges. Place in a large bowl.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half crosswise, then slice each half lengthwise; rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Quarter potatoes. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. Divide veggies between two large baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are tender and golden, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into a small bowl.

Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies have about 10 minutes left, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick strips. Season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) packages tempeh
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tempeh in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tempeh and veggies between plates. Drizzle with dressing and top with reserved dill. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 sticks celery
1 ½ lb red grapes
3 Gala apples
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grapes and add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Using your fingers, crumble tofu into small pieces. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the tofu salad.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates, then fill with "Waldorf" tofu salad. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 avocados
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Add mayo, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, oil, and salt to the bowl with the green onions; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu salad. Set aside.

Thinly slice jalapeño peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with avocado and tofu salad. Top with reserved green onions and jalapeño. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices sourdough bread
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with the vinegar, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup red wine vinegar
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add the cooled croutons and capers to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place soy sauce, oil, honey, and spices in a large baking dish. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes. Add to the baking dish with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ mangoes

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Juice limes into the bowl with the cilantro. Add mayo, soy sauce, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, stir combine the slaw, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: When the rice has about 10 minutes left, place tofu in the oven and bake, turning halfway through, until golden and warmed through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, and slaw between bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!
If using wooden skewers, place 6-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 ½ lemons
3 heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place mushrooms in a medium bowl. Add coconut aminos and spices, then toss to coat. Thread mushrooms onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the mushrooms directly on the grill pan.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp coconut aminos
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches, add mushroom skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and tender, about 10 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, oil, Dijon, coconut aminos, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup avocado oil mayonnaise
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp coconut aminos
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Place on another plate, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the steak is cooking, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad, steak, and mushrooms between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ limes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
Peel and mince ginger and shallot. Add both to the remaining bowl with the cilantro.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 shallot

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, and soy sauce to the bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the veggie ground mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
½ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into the reserved bowl with the cilantro. Add oil, sugar, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and hot sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Toast the buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Spread spicy mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.

Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium zucchini squash
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices to the bowl with the parsley; use your hands to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded "meatballs" and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
¾ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp nutmeg, ground
½ tsp cloves, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer meatballs to a large baking dish. (Reserve skillet with drippings for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add broth, cream, soy sauce, Dijon, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer sauce to the baking dish with the meatballs. Gently stir to cover meatballs with sauce.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until meatballs are cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles, meatballs, and sauce between plates. Top with remaining parsley and enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until almost done, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tempeh crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the garlic-oil, stir to coat, and set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (8 oz) packages tempeh

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 crowns broccoli
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, working in batches, add tempeh in a single layer; cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes.
While the tempeh is cooking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the tempeh is done, juice lemons into the pot.

Add drained pasta, broccoli, additional oil and spices, reserved pasta cooking water, and half of the basil to the pot. Toss to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add coconut milk, water, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) cans coconut milk
1 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 caps portobello mushrooms
6 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, soy sauce, water, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, turmeric, and curry powder. Whisk to combine the satay sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp curry powder

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; medium dice. Place in a large bowl, add half of the satay sauce, and stir to coat. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread mushrooms onto skewers and place on a large plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the mushroom pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, working in batches, add mushrooms and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred 3-4 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, chili-garlic sauce, and soy sauce in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the spicy marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the spicy marinade and gently toss to coat.

When the mushrooms are done, working in batches, add bok choy to the grill, and cook, flipping once, until tender and charred 3-4 minutes. Once done, add to the plate with the mushrooms. (Reserve any leftover marinade in the bowl for serving.)
To serve, divide coconut rice, bok choy, edamame, and mushroom skewers between plates. Drizzle reserved satay sauce over mushrooms and reserved spicy marinade over bok choy. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 sticks celery
1 lb red grapes
3 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl, then add yogurt, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:

instructions.primary_message: Divide tofu, potato, and broccoli between plates. Serve with lemon-pepper aioli on the side and enjoy!
Preheat the oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 tomatoes
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a large bowl and a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into the large bowl with the garlic. Juice lemons into the small bowl with the garlic, then add mayo, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the lemon-garlic sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, oil, vinegar, honey, and pepper to the large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu and place in another large bowl. Add cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then divide tofu between the baking sheet and another baking sheet. Spread out in an even layer and drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place tofu in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing once, until golden and warmed through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
When the tofu is almost done, using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide tofu and salad between plates. Drizzle sauce over tofu and enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices whole grain bread

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemons into a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
12 eggs
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with croutons, and gently toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates, then top with Parmesan and fried eggs. Enjoy!
Place veggie ground, eggs, bread crumbs, and spices in a large bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the veggie ground mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the patties are done on one side, flip, then top with cheese. Continue to cook until burgers are cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a clean large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with mayo, soy sauce, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp soy sauce
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Remove 3 whole lettuce leaves, cut in half, and set aside for the burgers. Chop (or tear) remaining lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and reserved lettuce. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ head romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the ground beef, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Form the mixture into 6 patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
3 tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, coat the bottom with coconut oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the beef patties on the grill pan or skillet and cook until desired doneness, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the patties to a plate.

While the patties cook, rip off a few lettuce leaves for the burgers and place on a plate. Then, trim off and discard the root end of the remaining lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; quarter the head lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Transfer the chopped lettuce to a large salad bowl.

Slice three of the tomatoes crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds for the burgers and add to the plate with the lettuce leaves. Halve the other tomatoes lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem end; large dice the tomato and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces on an angle and add to the salad bowl.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Toast the buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: To serve, assemble the burger and add any desired condiments. Serve with the salad on the side. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Break spaghetti into thirds.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add ginger, garlic, and veggie ground. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
24 oz veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

When the veggie ground is done, reduce heat to low. Add spinach and half of the basil to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Juice limes into the pot, then add the pasta, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the noodles and sauce between bowls; garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut tortillas into 8 triangles and place on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 small corn tortillas
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes.
Add beef to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the beef. Reduce heat to medium, stir, and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Wash and medium dice tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ head romaine lettuce
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Grate 1 ½ cup of cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, ketchup, olive oil, vinegar, honey, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp ketchup
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tsp honey
¾ tsp onion powder
⅜ tsp paprika
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place lettuce in a bowl, crush tortilla chips on top, and add beef and tomatoes. Sprinkle with cheddar and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Place in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 medium yellow potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash, peel, and small dice carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion, carrots, and ground beef. Break apart the beef with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until beef is browned and vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Transfer beef and vegetables to a colander and set aside.
Return skillet to stove. Add butter and flour; whisk until smooth. Add broth and soy sauce. Bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
12 fl oz (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
3 tsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Return beef and vegetables to skillet. Add peas, salt, and pepper. Mix well and cook until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup frozen peas
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add butter, broth, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
12 fl oz (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place beef and veggie mixture in a bowl or on a plate, top with mashed potatoes, and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!
Peel and small dice onions. Wash, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 red bell peppers
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and peppers. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add beef and garlic. Breaking apart with a spoon, cook until meat is browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce, vinegar, honey, soy sauce, Dijon, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce thickens, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tsp Dijon mustard
3 tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Toast buns or rolls if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: To serve, fill buns or rolls with sloppy joe mixture and enjoy with broccoli slaw on the side!

Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and lay side by side on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the spinach if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
6 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 small bunches cilantro
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the lime into a large bowl. Grate the ginger and add to the bowl with the juice. Add maple syrup, soy sauce, and oil; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup pure maple syrup
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu into 1-inch squares. Place tofu in the bowl with the marinade and gently toss until well coated; set aside.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Peel the carrots; run the peeler along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips.
Remove pot from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse; return to pot.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Use a slotted spoon to add the tofu to the skillet leaving the marinade in the bowl for later use. Cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Cook in batches if necessary.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu cooks, seed and cut the bell pepper into thin sticks.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Once the tofu is cooked, transfer to a plate, returning the skillet to the heat. Add the remaining marinade, bell pepper, carrot, green onions, and spinach to the hot skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add the tofu and vegetable mixture to the pot with the noodles and toss to combine.
Cut the remaining lime into wedges for serving.
To serve, divide noodles between bowls and top with tofu. Garnish with cilantro, peanuts, and a squeeze of lime; enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium spaghetti squash
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard ends of the squashes; halve each squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half. Rub the inside of the squash with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place the squashes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the green onion.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince shallots. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 shallots
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallots and garlic and cook until lightly golden, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Crack the eggs into a large bowl and season with salt and pepper; beat with a whisk or fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove skillet from heat and set aside.

Once tender, remove the squash halves from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
While the squash cools, juice the lime into a small bowl. Add soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, oil, and cayenne to bowl with lime juice; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
¼ cup pure maple syrup
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat; add spaghetti squash and sauce to the skillet with the egg and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Alternatively, reheat spaghetti squash with sauce in one skillet and the egg in another; combine when serving.
To serve, divide the pad Thai between plates or bowls and garnish with green onions, cilantro, and peanuts. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and maple syrup to the dish with the garlic; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup soy sauce
¼ cup rice vinegar
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Drain and cut tofu into 1-inch thick slices; sandwich the slices between clean towels or paper towels and gently press to remove excess water. Place tofu in the baking dish with the marinade and turn to coat; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
3 English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler), peel the carrots into noodle-like sticks; transfer to a large bowl.
Halve the tomatoes; trim cucumbers, slice lengthwise, and cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the carrots.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Working in batches if necessary, place marinated tofu on the grill and cook, flipping once, until charred, about 6 minutes. (Reserve remaining marinade for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Remove tofu from the grill, slice crosswise into strips, and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Add remaining marinade from the baking dish to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with peanuts. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb green beans
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard the ends of the green beans, then cut into 2-inch pieces; transfer to a large bowl.

Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 8-10 minutes. Add green beans to the pot and cook 2-3 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water; set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 oz penne pasta
1 tbsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the cannellini beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a salad bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop capers and olives. Transfer everything to the salad bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp capers
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Add cannellini beans, pasta, and green beans to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between dishes and garnish with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice potatoes.
Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince onions; peel, trim, and small dice carrots.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the onion and carrot. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are soft, add veggie ground to the skillet, along with half of the parsley and spices (reserving remaining parsley for garnish). Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggie ground is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the veggie ground is done, add garlic and soy sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add flour and tomato paste to the skillet; stir well, then add broth, peas, and corn. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
3 tbsp tomato paste
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup frozen peas
¾ cup frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain and return to the pot. Add broth, oil, garlic powder, and salt; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the veggie ground mixture to a large baking dish and spread evenly; top with mashed potatoes. Place in the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes begin to brown.
To serve, divide the Shepherd's pie between plates and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
